sentences.en: For three hundred years they have farmed the surrounding land.
sentences.zh: 他们在周围的土地上耕作了三百多年。

sentences.en: Some insects can take on the color of their surroundings.
sentences.zh: 有些昆虫可以变成与环境相同的颜色。

sentences.en: The marauders laid waste to the town and surrounding villages.
sentences.zh: 这些劫掠者摧毁了城镇及其周边的村庄。
